unresponsive.question: Is the robot completely unresponsive (no power-on, no network heartbeat)?

power_check.question: Does the robot draw normal idle current (> 0.1 A) when powered?

sensor_fault.question: Is the robot reporting sensor faults or abnormal sensor readings?

optical_sensor.question: Is the affected sensor optical (lidar / camera)?

bus_errors.question: Do I2C / data-bus errors appear in the system log?

motion_fault.question: Is the fault an overcurrent, drive, or motion fault?

free_movement.question: With drives de-energized, does the affected wheel/joint move freely by hand?

post_update.question: Did the fault begin after a firmware/config change, or is the robot reboot-looping?

actions: Measure battery pack voltage at the connector; compare to spec for BAT-9000/BAT-12000
Inspect power harness for chafing or intermittent opens (see RBT-006 harness history)
Charge or replace battery pack; verify part revision matches fleet baseline
If power delivery is good but robot stays dark, escalate to controller diagnosis
Reseat controller power and data connectors
Check controller fuse and status LEDs against the service manual
Attempt recovery boot / firmware reflash from known-good image
Replace controller module; record serial and firmware in fleet config
Clean optical window with approved optics wipes
Reseat lidar connector and inspect pins (recurrence pattern: RBT-003)
Run sensor self-test; compare point-cloud density to a known-good unit
If dropouts recur after reseat + clean, replace lidar and open RMA

leaf_wiring.diagnosis: Wiring / connector fault on sensor data bus
actions: Re-terminate the affected connector; verify crimp quality
Apply locking compound to prevent back-out (see RBT-007 IMU fix)
Add abrasion sleeve where harness contacts chassis
Wiggle-test under power while monitoring bus error counters

leaf_sensor_cal.diagnosis: Sensor drift or internal sensor failure
actions: Compare sensor reading against a calibrated external reference
Recalibrate per sensor procedure; if drift persists, replace module (see RBT-005 temp sensor)
Verify replacement against reference before returning robot to service
Log calibration values in the maintenance record
Measure motor winding resistance phase-to-phase; compare to DM-440/DM-880 spec
Inspect motor power connector for heat damage
Replace drive motor; recalibrate dependent sensors (load_cell on HaulBot, see RBT-004)
Run loaded test cycle and confirm current stays within limits
Identify the binding element by isolating each stage of the drivetrain
Replace seized bearing/caster assembly (see RBT-006 caster seizure)
Inspect adjacent components for debris or wear that caused the seizure
Lubricate per PM spec and run unloaded break-in before returning to service

leaf_software.diagnosis: Software / firmware regression (watchdog loop, config fault)
actions: Capture logs before any reset - preserve evidence for root cause
Roll back the most recent config change (see RBT-003 watchdog loop)
Update firmware to the fleet baseline version if the unit is behind
Soak-test for 24 h before clearing the fault

leaf_escalate.diagnosis: Unclassified fault - escalate with full evidence package
actions: Capture full system logs, telemetry export, and photos of the unit
Record exact symptom timeline and any recent maintenance in the ticket
Tag the robot out of service and update fleet status to 'down'
Escalate to site engineering with the evidence package
